# eBay Canada

> eBay Canada is a comprehensive online marketplace offering electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles, and more with integrated auction, daily deals, and seller tools.

eBay Canada provides a full-featured e-commerce platform for buyers and sellers, with robust account management, security verification, and specialized features like Motors for vehicle parts and My Garage for automotive enthusiasts. The platform emphasizes user authentication and fraud prevention across all transaction types.

## Key Topics

- eBay Marketplace
- Account Security
- Identity Verification
- My eBay Dashboard
- Auction Listings
- Daily Deals
- Seller Tools
- eBay Motors
- Product Categories
- Advanced Search
- Shipping Options
- User Authentication
- Security Verification
- Purchase History
- Watchlist Management

## Marketplace & Shopping

- [eBay Canada Homepage](https://www.ebay.ca): eBay Canada homepage with marketplace categories, auctions, and specialty products.
- [Daily Deals](https://www.ebay.ca/deals): eBay daily deals marketplace with discounted electronics and footwear.
- [Advanced Search](https://www.ebay.ca/sch/ebayadvsearch): eBay advanced search with filters for category, price, and condition.

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign in or Register](https://signin.ebay.ca/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay account login and registration with social login options.
- [Security Verification](https://signup.ebay.ca/pa/crte): eBay account verification and security measure page.

## My eBay Dashboard

- [My eBay Home](https://www.ebay.ca/mys/home): eBay My eBay account home with security verification.
- [My eBay Summary](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/summary): eBay My eBay summary page with account verification.
- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/purchase): eBay My eBay purchase history with security verification.
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/watchlist): eBay My eBay watchlist with security verification.
- [Bids & Offers](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): eBay My eBay bids and offers with fraud prevention.
- [Saved Items](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/saved): eBay My eBay saved items with account security verification.
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/savedsearches): eBay My eBay saved searches with security verification.
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/savedsellers): eBay My eBay saved sellers with user authentication.
- [Recently Viewed Items](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/rvi): eBay My eBay recent viewed items with security verification.
- [Messages](https://mesg.ebay.ca/mesgweb/ViewMessages/0): eBay messaging center with security verification.

## Selling & Specialized Features

- [Selling on eBay](https://www.ebay.ca/sl/sell): eBay seller guide with listing basics, fees, and shipping options.
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.ca/g/mygarage): eBay My Garage for vehicle-specific parts and accessories.

## Support & Help

- [eBay Customer Service](https://www.ebay.ca/help/home): eBay help center with buying, selling, and account support FAQs.
